packageRules.description: Bump .nvmrc and the Dockerfile Node base image together, keeping the exact runtime pin and dev/prod parity in lockstep (spec: runtime-baseline).

Hold TypeScript majors. The source is TS7-ready, but the toolchain is not: typescript-eslint pins `typescript <6.1.0` (it hard-throws above, taking lint and the boundaries test with it) and svelte-check declares `^5 || ^6` and crashes at module load. A version bump is therefore the wrong shape — the tested adoption path is tsgo side-by-side (keep typescript@^6, add @typescript/native-preview, point typecheck and svelte-check at tsgo). Lift this once both peers accept TS>=7.
